message.reasoning:
We need to answer based on policy excerpts. The user asks: "What exact date does my next invoice get generated? I need to plan around replacing my card."

We have excerpts:

[DOC-007] part 1: monthly plan is invoiced on same day of month as workspace's original billing date — the date subscription started or last renewed.

[DOC-007] part 2: That date is shown in Settings → Billing → Plan next to “Next invoice”, and it does not shift month to month even though months have different lengths; a billing date of the 31st bills on the last day of a shorter month.

[DOC-007] part 3: Because the card charge happens on that date, replacing a card a day or two beforehand is enough for the new card to be used for the upcoming invoice.

Thus we can answer: The next invoice date is the billing date of your workspace, which is the same day of month as original subscription start/renewal, shown in Settings → Billing → Plan next to “Next invoice”. It does not shift; if it's 31st, it bills on last day of shorter months. So you can replace card a day or two before that date.

Thus we can answer with that info. Provide specific guidance: check Settings → Billing → Plan to see date. So answer.

We must post reply.

arguments.message: Your next invoice will be generated on the billing date that was set when your workspace’s subscription started (or last renewed). You can see the exact day in **Settings → Billing → Plan** next to “Next invoice.” That date stays the same each month – for example, a 31st billing date will bill on the last day of shorter months. Because the card charge occurs on that day, swapping in a new card a day or two before the listed date is enough for the new card to be used for the upcoming invoice.
